1.consolidated_definition: "Amancebarse": (verb) unirse o asociarse con alguien o algo para establecer una relación de intercambio o beneficio mutuo.
1.en_consolidated_definition: To amancebarse (verb): to form an alliance or association with someone or something in order to establish a mutually beneficial relationship of exchange.
